title: CIRSEC Baselines - Linux sysctl check spec

key.description: e.g. net.ipv4.ip_forward. Check reads the running value, fix sets it now and persists it in /etc/sysctl.d/.

operator.description: How the observed value compares to value. match = regex.

value.description: Expected value. May be a single {{ parameter }}, resolved with its type.
